blocks.text: NAGOYA– Accommodation for Asian Games 2026 athletes in Japan is “functional” and efforts are being made to deal with numerous complaints from disgruntled teams, a chief organiser told AFP. More than 17,000 competitors and officials are expected at the continent’s biggest sporting spectacular, which opens on Saturday in Nagoya. READ: Asian Games 2026 set for liftoff but will everyone have a bed? In a bid to cut costs, organizers are housing athletes and officials in temporary accommodation ranging from a cruise liner and wooden containers to hotel rooms.
